resolved_findings: Default workspace cleanup failure must report incomplete unless retention was explicitly requested.
Directory enumeration must enforce the entry cap before retaining entries, including vanished hints.
Cleanup must validate ancestry and signal pinned kernel pidfds rather than recycled numeric descendant PIDs.
A previously pinned child remains owned after reparenting; live unproven hints remain outside the signal path and prevent complete cleanup.
Only the live retained-byte budget scan may tolerate vanished temporary entries; content-preservation witnesses remain strict.
Quota controls must distinguish native policy/Ask authorization from actual reservation and commit counters.
scope: Correctness, privacy, resource bounds and regressions; not a repository security certification or final shared admission.
